PROP-attendanceze-asm-003.text: Discord OAuth provider returns valid provider_id in user_metadata on successful auth.
PROP-attendanceze-asm-003.assertion: forall oauth_success: user.user_metadata.provider_id is valid discord_uid string

locations.note: Reads user.user_metadata.provider_id as discordUid (line 58). Assumes Discord OAuth provider populates this field. If null, shows error at line 59-69.
Uses user.user_metadata.provider_id as discord_uid (line 287) when inserting member record. Assumption dependency.
